description: This topic is a highly crucial segment of General Science. It covers major scientists, their groundbreaking inventions, and foundational discoveries that are directly and frequently asked in competitive exams.

sections.title: Important Scientific Facts
sections.description: Crucial one-liner facts and superlatives regarding discoveries often asked in static GK sections.

important_facts.fact: Edward Jenner is widely recognized and referred to as the 'Father of Immunology'.
Marie Curie is the only woman to win Nobel Prizes in two different scientific fields (Physics in 1903 and Chemistry in 1911).
Robert Hooke was the first scientist to discover and coin the term 'Cell' in the year 1665.
Alexander Fleming famously discovered Penicillin accidentally from a mold named 'Penicillium notatum'.
